subject: RE: Payments — PCI-DSS Compliance Blocker
body:
Hi Priya,

My PCI-DSS audit found a critical blocker: our infrastructure does not meet PCI-DSS Level 1 for cardholder data.

Gaps:
1. No network segmentation between payments and the general app layer.
2. Card transaction audit logging not implemented.
3. A third-party penetration test is required before certification.

The pen test alone has a 3-4 week lead time. December 15 is no longer achievable. I raised this in NEX-217 and we discussed it in standup_03. Targeting mid-January at the earliest.

Kenji Nakamura, Security Lead
